title: Business Spaces, Members, Channels and every hub page open on the plain header Around You and Events use, with no photo band
detail: Daniel 2026-10-19: make Business Spaces the same header style as Around You and Events (remove the header image, every button cleanly represented); remove the Members header; standardize the Channels header. Under Frequency, MarketHero (Business Spaces, Channels, Housing, Store and the other browse headers) now renders the kit .head through PageHeading with the search on its own row, and IndexTemplate's overlay branch falls through to the same head (Members, Friends, My Contacts, Messages, Journeys, Practices, Help and the other overlay indexes), so no hub page carries a photo band. The hero buttons are the kit pills (btn pa / btn) on the canvas instead of the on-ink pair. Channels' loading screen waits on the plain head. DAWN is unchanged. Page threads adopt this header as they rebuild each body.
